segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the moisturizer hydrates without adding oiliness or greasiness and does not break them out.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it relieves dryness and adds needed moisture without becoming heavy.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report it does not irritate and, for one long-time acne sufferer, caused no breakouts despite very sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin report it moisturizes well and one notes it seems to smooth wrinkles/lines.
segments.combination: One reviewer who switched from a previous Proactiv line to the sensitive-skin version found it worked less well and less fast than the prior product.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature/aging skin report the moisturizer softens the skin and one describes it as seeming to smooth wrinkles and lines.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers report their dryness is resolved and skin feels soft and moisturized, including one with sensitive skin that dries out easily.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several describe reduced breakouts, cleared acne, or fewer pimples over weeks to a year of use, but multiple reviewers (including parents of teenage users) report no improvement in acne after weeks of twice-daily use, and one describes ongoing pimples despite consistent use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports lightening of dark spots on a family member's skin after use.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers, including some who self-identify as oily-skinned, report the product hydrates without making skin oily or greasy.
